name: framework_route_mount_unresolved correctly reported using coverage.ts's own recommended wording
description: M4 gate 4 reopening (docs/work/task-m4-gate4-mount-false-positive.md, post-hoc audit finding 5): before LIMITATION_SURFACE_PATTERNS gained an entry for this code, surfacesLimitation() fell through to its default - a regex requiring the literal underscored code name ('framework route mount unresolved') in prose. coverage.ts's own message text ('this does not mean the route is unmounted') never says that, so a summary following the docs exactly was reported as missing_high_severity_disclosure. Direct measurement against the pre-fix engine (this exact response/summary pair) reproduced that false positive. Deliberately does NOT use SKILL.md's alternate paraphrase ('this is not evidence the route is unreachable') here - that phrase's 'not evidence' collides with the already-known, separately-tracked stale_index_caveat gap (finding 4, gap 3's unscoped first branch: ANY 'index' mention anywhere in the summary plus ANY 'not evidence'/'unproven'/etc. anywhere else falsely fires, even under indexingStatus: ready) - reproduced directly while building this fixture, not assumed; left as further evidence for finding 4, not fixed here per that finding's own scope (comment/cross-reference only, no regex change). Must-pass fixture.
